name: timekeeper
description: Dashboard estática de contadores com Firebase Auth e Firestore.

scripts.check: npm run check:syntax && npm run test:unit
scripts.check:syntax: node --check public/src/time.js && node --check public/src/analytics.js && node --check public/src/firebase.js && node --check scripts/serve-public.cjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.rules-test.json --project demo-timekeeper --only firestore,storage "node --test tests/rules/firestore.test.cjs"
